limitations: One isolated validation request; trusted fixed-dialect initialization occurs before input delivery, with separate startup and request deadlines.

Real worker tests cover current, legacy and implicit dialects, schema-id isolation, ordinary invalid input, and termination of expensive regular-expression validation while the host event loop remains responsive.

The model assumes fair settlement and does not prove wall-clock scheduling, schema semantics, worker-capacity bounds or OS thread reaping. Startup-timeout and worker-crash branches are modeled, not induced by the conformance suite.
